secondaryAuthorities.name: TaskState
secondaryAuthorities.resolution: TaskState is agent-level execution state, not workflow state. Added documentation clarifying it does not compete with CanonicalWorkflowState.

secondaryAuthorities.name: WorkflowStatus
secondaryAuthorities.resolution: Added deprecation notice mapping WorkflowStatus to CanonicalWorkflowState. Kept for backward compatibility with creation endpoints.

secondaryAuthorities.name: CreationMode
secondaryAuthorities.resolution: Added deprecation notice. CreationMode allows workflow bypass which violates M2.9 architecture. Scheduled for removal in Wave 1 / Agent B13.

unit.note: Pre-existing failures in certification gates. No new failures introduced by canonical workflow changes.
